items.heading: Four Years of Engineering Gave
items.text: Four Years of Engineering Gave Four Years of Engineering Gave Four years of engineering gave you problem-solving, numbers and a technical vocabulary. It did not give you a ready route. The market now pays for skill you can show, and three numbers explain why.

items.heading: The Routes Below Are Ordered
items.text: The routes below are ordered by how much income and reach can realistically grow, not by prestige or exam difficulty. Skill-led routes come first because you set the pace and the price.

items.heading: Two People with the Same
items.text: Two people with the same branch can have very different best routes. Use your own numbers on this table. It shows which doors stay open and which need extra care. Convert your CGPA with the CGPA to percentage calculator .
